settings.title: System settings
settings.description: Changes apply immediately and save automatically.
settings.color-mode-note: Follow your system or choose a light or dark interface.
settings.contrast-note: Give text, borders and controls stronger definition.
settings.language-note: Switch the interface language without leaving your work.
settings.font-scale-note: Scale text across the entire interface.
settings.density-note: Adjust control height and button padding.
settings.material-note: Adaptive transparency falls back to solid where needed.
settings.radius-note: Tune the corners of controls and panels together.
settings.radius-custom: Your custom radius is kept until you choose a preset.
settings.motion-note: Choose motion intensity. System reduced-motion preferences are always respected.
settings.navigation-collapsed-note: Keep the sidebar collapsed on wide layouts.
settings.navigation-accordion-note: Keep one navigation group open at a time.
settings.scroll-restoration-note: Restore your position after a page or workspace refresh.
settings.reset-note: Reset color, typography, density, radius and motion preferences.
settings.feedback.rejected: This setting could not be saved. Your previous appearance is restored.
settings.feedback.applied-not-saved: Applied for this session, but could not be saved. Try changing it again.
settings.feedback.unavailable: This setting is unavailable right now. Your choice was not changed.
settings.feedback.language-failed: The language could not be changed. Your previous language is still active.
settings.feedback.return-failed: Could not return to your workspace. Try Done again.
